offering_description.value: Owns and operates midstream pipelines and plants that gather, process and transport natural gas and natural gas liquids from producers in the Permian Basin. Sells processed gas and liquids to petrochemical, refining and export customers, and earns fees for handling volumes.

primary_products.value: natural gas; natural gas liquids; condensate

primary_services.value: gas gathering and processing; natural gas liquids transportation and fractionation; produced water handling; natural gas transmission

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers shipping gas and water, petrochemical, refining and export buyers of liquids

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; petrochemicals; energy exports

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: gathering, processing and transportation fees paid by producers per volume handled; product sales: residue gas and natural gas liquids sold to buyers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gathering systems, processing plants and pipelines, takes in gas from producers and sells to petrochemical and export customers; service provider: provides midstream processing and transport services under long-term contracts

geography_served.value: US regional: Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico, and Texas Gulf Coast

specialization.value: related lines: gathering and processing, liquids transportation and fractionation, and water management, all serving the same producers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term gathering and processing contracts with producers and direct sales of liquids to buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pipeline safety and interstate gas transport rules from FERC and PHMSA, plus state and EPA environmental and air permits

notes: Business details may have changed after my knowledge cutoff, such as recent acquisitions or expansions.
